headline: Tanzania Invites RMB and IFC to Finance Public Enterprises, Publishes Audited Accounts
summary: Tanzania's Treasury Registrar has approached RMB and IFC about financing public enterprises and published 2024/25 audited accounts. Discussions covered infrastructure, renewable energy, agriculture, transport, telecoms, mining and pharmaceuticals.
why: The International Finance Corporation is the World Bank Group's private-sector lending arm, and public enterprise financing affects state-owned companies' credit and investment pipelines.
